title: Drawn-Response Capture-Quality Record
$comment: Defined by docs/research/TASK-0011_PHASE_1_EXECUTION_SPEC.md section 5 and section 7.1. Capture quality is labeled before any visual observation or scoring (section 6.2 step 2) and describes the image, not the student's graph quality (section 5: 'Missing axis labels on a clear photograph are a scoring observation, not a capture failure').

CAPTURE_DISPOSITION.description: Spec section 5 and 7.1. RETAKE only when recapture can plausibly fix the defect; otherwise HUMAN_REVIEW.

source_image_id.description: ID of the immutable original capture being labeled.

response_id.description: Tooling envelope field; the underlying response this capture belongs to.

capture_reviewer_id.description: Spec section 6.1: the Capture Reviewer labels image quality without seeing criterion outcomes. Tooling envelope field naming that role's reviewer.
